paper.title_en: On the bin sensitivity of the transverse BAO
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the transverse BAO projection effect caused by redshift binning uncertainty ($z_c$). For SKA HI and DESI LRG surveys, we compare Gaussian, top-hat, and semi-Gaussian bins over widths $0.01<σ_z<0.1$, and propose a statistical correction using adjacent redshifts. The semi-Gaussian bin best recovers the BAO signal for $σ_z<0.04$, despite higher shot noise. Constraints are survey-dependent: Gaussian binning is weakest for SKA, while for DESI semi-Gaussian is tightest for $σ_z<0.04$ (otherwise comparable). The semi-Gaussian scheme offers the optimal balance between cosmological parameter constraints and BAO fidelity, making it robust for multi-probe analyses.
